findings.rationale: An IAM role named 'admin' has a policy that allows it to be assumed by a broad set of principals, granting administrative privileges.
An IAM policy named 'assume_broadly' grants sts:AssumeRole permission to a wide range of principals, potentially allowing unauthorized role assumption.
An IAM role named 'external_trust' explicitly trusts an external AWS account as a principal, which can be a high-risk security vulnerability.

findings.control: identity boundary: MFA condition on sensitive trust
findings.rationale: The IAM role 'external_trust' trusts an external principal without enforcing multi-factor authentication (MFA) for assuming the role, increasing the risk of unauthorized access.
